targets.title: Remote computers
targets.subtitle: Connect Lumora to native agents on another computer.
targets.description: Configure SSH access and open an isolated Lumora window for each computer.
targets.delete-description: This removes the saved profile from Lumora. It does not change the remote computer.
targets.delete-confirm: Delete {name} from Lumora? Lumora will close its remote window and connection, but will not change anything on the remote computer.
targets.fingerprint-help: Compare this SHA-256 fingerprint with the remote computer before trusting it.

profile.name: Name
profile.secret-help: Passwords and key passphrases are requested only when connecting and are never saved.

validation.name: Enter a name for this remote computer.
validation.ssh-alias: Enter one OpenSSH config alias without spaces.

errors.load-targets: Lumora could not load remote computers.
errors.save-target: Lumora could not save this remote computer. Check the fields and try again.
errors.delete-target: Lumora could not delete this remote computer. Disconnect it and try again.
errors.read-identity: Lumora could not read the remote computer identity.
errors.save-fingerprint: Lumora could not save the trusted fingerprint.
errors.close-connection: Lumora could not close this remote connection safely.
errors.load-target: Lumora could not load this remote target.
errors.inspect-helper: Lumora could not inspect the remote helper installation.
errors.load-runtime: Lumora could not load the remote terminal runtime.
errors.forget-credential: Lumora could not forget the remembered SSH credential.
errors.update-auto-connect: Lumora could not update automatic connection for this profile.
errors.disconnect: Lumora could not disconnect this remote computer cleanly.
errors.install-helper: Lumora could not install or start the remote helper.
errors.save-providers: The remote provider selection could not be saved.
errors.save-setting: Lumora could not save this remote setting.
errors.hide-workspace: Lumora could not hide this remote workspace. Try again.
errors.restore-workspaces: Lumora could not restore the selected remote workspaces. Try again.
errors.restore-all-workspaces: Lumora could not restore hidden remote workspaces. Try again.
errors.auto-connect-after-connection: The SSH connection succeeded, but automatic connection could not be enabled.

connection-errors.authentication-failed: SSH authentication failed. Check the profile username and enter the same credential that works in a native SSH client.
connection-errors.host-key-changed: The remote computer identity changed. Return to local Lumora and verify its host fingerprint before reconnecting.
connection-errors.timeout: The SSH connection timed out. Check that the remote computer is reachable and its SSH service is responding.
connection-errors.connection-failed: Lumora could not establish the SSH connection. Check the host, port, SSH service, and network route.
connection-errors.platform-probe-failed: SSH connected, but Lumora could not identify the remote operating system. Check that the account can run non-interactive shell commands.
connection-errors.helper-bundle-failed: SSH connected, but Lumora could not verify a helper for this operating system and architecture. Rebuild the helper bundle or use a packaged Lumora build.
connection-errors.file-transfer-failed: SSH connected, but Lumora could not open the remote file-transfer service. Check that the SSH server has SFTP enabled.
connection-errors.helper-inspection-failed: SSH connected, but Lumora could not inspect the remote helper installation. Check the remote account permissions and try again.
connection-errors.credential-required: Lumora needs the SSH credential again. Enter it below to reconnect manually.
connection-errors.credential-unavailable: The remembered SSH credential is unavailable. Enter it below to reconnect manually.
connection-errors.operation-failed: Lumora could not connect to this remote computer. Check the profile and try again.

shell.home-description: Review the connected target and its most recent provider sessions.
shell.workspaces-description: Browse provider-owned workspace groupings discovered on this computer.
shell.sessions-description: Search and resume provider-owned sessions from this computer.
shell.settings-description: Configure target-scoped providers and inspect this connection.

overview.verify-first: Verify this computer in the local Lumora window before authentication.

authentication.secure-storage-description: Protect this credential with the operating system's secure storage.
authentication.auto-connect-description: Attempt this profile once when its remote Lumora window opens.
authentication.storage-unavailable: Secure credential storage is unavailable. Lumora will keep this credential in memory for the current connection only.

environment.description: Node.js and npm are checked on this remote computer only.
environment.unsupported: This remote helper cannot scan providers yet. Reconnect and update the Lumora helper from Overview.
environment.scan-error: Lumora could not scan this remote computer. The SSH connection remains open.
environment.probe-failed: Lumora found {name}, but {command} did not complete successfully on the remote computer.
environment.not-found: Install or repair {name} on the remote computer, then refresh this page.

connection.failed: Lumora could not connect to this remote computer.

helper.description: Lumora uses a lightweight helper to inspect providers, sessions, and terminals.
helper.install-description: Lumora will install its lightweight helper for your account on {target}. Administrator access is not required.
helper.invalid-replace: The existing helper is invalid and will be replaced only after the new copy has been verified.
helper.unsupported: No verified helper is available for this operating system and architecture.

window.cached-catalog: Your current page and cached catalog remain available.
window.active-agents: {count, plural, one {# remote agent} other {# remote agents}}
window.isolation-note: Environment, providers, launch settings, sessions, and terminals stay isolated to this target.
